text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's goin' on? There's nobody here!
But I swear
I heard someone say a
festival was 'bout to start.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're the Three Goddesses, right?
How's
business been treatin' ya? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, endin' up here musta been some
kinda
destiny or somethin'. Guess I
should pay my
respects!
